protocols.sectionSubheadline: Doctor-ordered clinical diagnostic panels, epigenetic longevity testing, and functional medicine biomarkers.

items.name: GI Gut Map Stool Test
items.description: The Gut IQ Profile is a comprehensive stool analysis providing a broad view of overall gut health by combining PCR and genomic sequencing technologies. Metagenomic sequencing analyzes the genetic material of entire microbial communities in a stool sample. This technique, known as shotgun sequencing, randomly and unbiasedly sequences all genetic material, covering over 28,000 microbial species. Unlike targeted approaches, it offers a comprehensive view, revealing previously unknown or unculturable microorganisms. From a simple stool sample, it provides detailed information on the microbiome and biochemical markers related to digestion, inflammation, and intestinal permeability.

items.name: MycoToxin Urine Analysis Panel
items.description: The MycoToxin Panel tests for 16 of the most common mycotoxins emitted by 300 varieties of molds providing insights into potential mold toxicity, chronic fatigue, immune suppression, and environmental exposures.

items.name: TruAge + TruHealth Epigenetic Panel
items.method: Single Blood Draw • DNA Methylation Sequencing
items.description: The Combination Kit brings together TruAge and TruHealth from a single blood collection, pairing insights into biological aging with epigenetic indicators of health. TruAge assesses biological age, pace of aging, and aging across 11 organ systems through OMICmAge, DunedinPACE, and SYMPHONYAge. TruHealth adds context through markers related to metabolic health, inflammation, immune function, nutrition, hormones, and environmental exposures. Together, they provide a comprehensive foundation for establishing a baseline and tracking changes over time.

items.name: OVI Hormone Panel (via Quest Labs)
items.method: Venous Blood Draw via Quest Diagnostics
items.description: Essential clinical baseline panel testing comprehensive testosterone levels (total, free, bioavailable), estradiol, sex hormone binding globulin, prostate health (PSA), full metabolic function, liver and kidney chemistry, and complete blood counts.

items.name: OVI Full Functional Panel
items.method: Comprehensive Diagnostic Draw via Quest Labs
items.description: Our most complete clinical blood evaluation for optimizing healthspan. Pairs full hormone and thyroid profiles with advanced cardiovascular markers (ApoB, Lipoprotein(a), Homocysteine, hs-CRP), heavy metal toxicity (Lead, Mercury, Arsenic), vitamin levels (B12, D, Ferritin), and autoimmune antibodies.

myths.myth: My doctor said my bloodwork is normal, so why do I feel bad?
myths.reality: Standard labs use wide population averages to spot disease. You can be in the 'normal' range and still have low energy or sub-optimal hormones. We test for optimal health ranges.

myths.myth: Do I need to fast before getting my blood drawn?
myths.reality: For most comprehensive hormone and lipid panels, yes—a simple 8 to 12 hour overnight fast (water is okay) gives our doctor the cleanest, most accurate health reading.

myths.myth: Is doctor-guided lab testing covered or simple?
myths.reality: Yes! We make lab testing easy and seamless. You can get drawn right at our St. Petersburg clinic or at a local lab, followed by a full doctor consult.

faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's order to get advanced lab testing?
faqs.answer: Our licensed medical doctor provides the required lab order! You will consult with our medical team, who orders your custom panel based on your specific health goals and symptoms.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided lab program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes the physician lab order, your blood draw at our clinic or a local lab partner, a complete lab analysis, and a detailed 1-on-1 doctor consultation to explain your results.

faqs.question: Where do I go to get my blood drawn?
faqs.answer: You can get your blood drawn right here at our comfortable St. Petersburg medical clinic, or we can send an order to a convenient local Quest or LabCorp near you!

faqs.question: How long does it take to get my lab results back?
faqs.answer: Most routine hormone and metabolic lab results return within 3 to 5 business days. Specialized genetic or heavy metal panels typically take 7 to 10 days.

faqs.question: Will the doctor explain my numbers and create a treatment plan?
faqs.answer: 100% yes! You won't be left guessing. Our doctor will walk you through every single marker in plain English and design a custom treatment plan (TRT, weight loss, peptides, or vitamins) tailored to your body.

faqs.question: How do I get started with advanced lab testing?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Call our clinic today at (727) 476-8966 or click 'Book Your Doctor Consultation' online. Our doctor will order your custom lab panel today!

labsGuide.title: Better Insights. Smarter Wellness. Personalized Care.
intro: At OVI Wellness, we believe understanding your health starts with understanding what’s happening inside your body. Our comprehensive lab testing options provide valuable insights into hormone levels, gut health, biological aging, metabolic function, and more.
Whether you’re looking to optimize your wellness or investigate specific health concerns, our testing options help you and your provider make informed decisions about your health.

tests.subtitle: Gut Health & Microbiome Analysis

tests.why: Gain a deeper understanding of your digestive health and identify potential imbalances that may help guide a personalized wellness plan.

tests.name: Mycotoxin Urine Analysis Panel

Immune function and hormonal health markers
